question: A person can row at 10 km/hr in still water. The speed of the stream is 1(1)/(9) m/sec. The time (in hours) taken by him to row a distance of 72 km upstream is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert **Stream Speed**: (10/9) × (18/5) = 4 km/hr.

Calculate **Upstream Speed**: 10 − 4 = 6 km/hr.

Find **Time Taken**: 72 ÷ 6 = 12 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of person in **still water** (u) = 10 km/hr

Speed of the **stream** (v) = 1(1/9) m/sec = 10/9 m/sec

Total **Distance** (D) = 72 km

**Formula Used:**

Speed in km/hr = Speed in m/sec × (18/5)

**Upstream Speed** = u − v

**Time** = Distance ÷ Upstream Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bae65943c958188e68d484d893f9d3b75d533ef4f4dc8f11d5ded0d1ba26973.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Conversion of v: (10/9) × (18/5) km/hr

⇒ v = 2 × 2 = 4 km/hr

⇒ Upstream Speed = 10 − 4 = 6 km/hr

⇒ Time Taken = 72 ÷ 6

⇒ Time Taken = 12 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 12 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Downstream Speed

When a person rows with the flow of the stream, the speed is added: Downstream Speed = u + v.

Speed in Still Water and Stream

If Downstream (D) and Upstream (U) speeds are known, Still Water Speed = (D + U)/2 and Stream Speed = (D − U)/2.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/sec, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/sec to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p
